key_terms.الْبَيْتِ: The House (referring to the celestial Kaaba)

ai.seo_question: What is Al-Bayt Al-Ma'mur in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, Al-Bayt Al-Ma'mur is often interpreted as the spiritual center of the heavens, closely linked to the Imams or the Prophet Muhammad, serving as the destination for the circumambulation of angels. This celestial Kaaba underscores the cosmic hierarchy and the divine order, reinforcing the oath's emphasis on the inevitability of resurrection and the truth of the Hereafter.
